Odile.fixed: brisk handsome woman of fifty, speaker of Nine Spires, warm tan skin, dark brown hair with grey streaks swept back into a neat low knot, brown eyes, strong clear features; fine pale blue-green sea-silk in an island cut with a high soft collar. Expressions: odile_brisk, odile_cool (eyes cooled, mouth flat).

Hanne (the woman from engines, ch12 expr.fixed: same woman from engines as chapter 9 (named Hanne in c12.s01.p001.5); new expression hanne_awed (eyes wide, looking up). Use enginewoman_guarded for her otherwise.

places.Bright Shelves from the tug deck (ch12): pale green water so clear the white sand floor, dark seagrass and glass coral are visible, silverbacks drifting, a corner of dark tug rail and wooden deck lower left, nine white towers on the horizon (bg c12_shelves_deck). Surface view, no ripple.
places.Nine Spires apron (ch12): nine tall slender white fluted tapering towers rising from the sea, broad pale stone aprons at the tide line with driftfolk rafts, boats, crates, washing and awnings, daylight (bg c12_apron).
places.Tower room, Nine Spires, night (ch12): round white stone room high in the eastern tower, wide open window on a dark sea and stars with lamps along the sill, narrow bed, small table and stool, plain wooden door (bg c12_tower_room).
places.Tidehall, centre (ch12): entirely underwater: empty white sand floor in a huge round terraced pale stone bowl, hundreds of small dark holds and doorways on the tiers, morning sun nets of light on the stone (bg c12_tidehall_centre).
places.Tidehall, rim at dusk (ch12): entirely underwater: pale stone terraces curving down to the white sand, a block of empty tiers, deep blue-green water with the last amber light from the surface at upper left, glass coral on the rim (bg c12_tidehall_rim_dusk).
